title: Viva Engage: Community Agent drafts and posts answers in communities
summary: The roadmap facts, preview licensing, admin paths and licence-assignment API are supported. Two minor corrections concern the source for site-owner permissions and a sensitivity-label checklist instruction without a corresponding controls row.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Community Agent is an AI agent that drafts answers to questions in Viva Engage communities, especially repeated questions.
claims.quote: Community Agent is an AI agent for Viva Engage communities. It helps community admins and experts answer questions, especially ones that come up repeatedly.

claims.claim: The agent uses conversations in its community as knowledge.
claims.quote: Conversations in this community | Included automatically.

claims.claim: The community's connected SharePoint library is included automatically.
claims.quote: The community's connected SharePoint library | Included automatically.

claims.claim: An admin can add extra SharePoint sites or libraries as knowledge sources using Add SharePoint site.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; controls[2].note; Scope
claims.claim: An admin can add public websites as knowledge sources using Add public website.
claims.quote: Public websites | Select Add public website to add them.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Posted agent answers appear as replies to the original questions for other community members to read.
claims.quote: Posted answers appear as replies to the original questions, where other community members can find and use them.

claims.claim: The Learn documentation describes public preview and warns that the design can change before general availability.
claims.quote: The Community Agent feature is in public preview. Features in preview may change before general availability release.

claims.claim: The preview toggle is at Engage admin center > Tenant settings > Community Agent preview.
claims.quote: Go to the Engage admin center and select Tenant settings. Turn on the Community Agent preview toggle.

claims.claim: A network admin must enable public preview before community admins can add the agent.
claims.quote: A network admin must enable the public preview before community admins can add Community Agent.

claims.claim: A new network-wide Community Agent setting will replace the preview toggle at general availability.
claims.quote: At general availability, a new network-wide Community Agent setting will replace this preview toggle.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft promises at least 30 days' notice before replacing the preview toggle.
claims.quote: We'll provide at least 30 days' notice and make the new setting available at the start of that notice period, so you can set your network's preference before general availability.

claims.claim: The replacement setting will be available from the start of the notice period.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: The general availability default is not stated, and no source states that existing behaviour changes if nobody acts.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Community Agent general availability default' and 'Community Agent require review network enforce tenant policy'. Read roadmap, Community Agent and search excerpts: preview opt-in and replacement setting are described, but no GA default or automatic migration behaviour.

claims.claim: Community admins can add one Community Agent per community.
claims.quote: Community admins can add one Community Agent per community.

claims.claim: The setup route is community > Admin actions > Set up community agent > Agent settings > Require review before posting.
claims.quote: On the community page, under Admin actions, select Set up community agent. On the Agent settings page, choose whether to turn on Require review before posting.

claims.where: controls[1].note; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: In public preview, the community agent posts answers automatically by default.
claims.quote: By default, the agent posts answers automatically.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Community admins can turn on Require review before posting so a community admin or expert must approve answers first.
claims.quote: Turn this setting on to require a community admin or expert to review and approve answers before they are posted.

claims.claim: Low confidence also requires a community admin or expert to approve the answer before posting.
claims.quote: If Require review before posting is on, or the agent has low confidence in its answer, a community admin or expert must approve the answer before it is posted.

claims.claim: The agent skips questions that already have a Best or Verified answer.
claims.quote: It skips questions with a Best or Verified answer, or questions older than 14 days.

claims.claim: The agent skips questions older than 14 days.
claims.quote: It skips questions with a Best or Verified answer, or questions older than 14 days.

claims.claim: The agent does not respond when its sources provide no relevant information.
claims.quote: If it finds no relevant information in its sources, it doesn't respond.

claims.claim: Reviewers can approve, edit or dismiss drafts.
claims.quote: Reviewers can approve, edit, or dismiss drafts.

claims.claim: Knowledge sources are managed at community > More items (...) > Settings > Agent settings > Knowledge.
claims.quote: To change the agent's settings, open the More items (...) menu in the community header, select Settings > Agent settings. Manage the sources and settings below in the Knowledge section of Agent settings.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Scope; controls[2].note; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Include public community content enables grounding in other public communities in the same Engage network.
claims.quote: Turn on Include public community content to let Community Agent draw on content from other Engage public communities in your Engage network.

claims.claim: Include public community content is off by default.
claims.quote: This setting is off by default. Public websites are added separately.

claims.claim: Only use expert and verified content is an available setting and is off by default.
claims.quote: Turn on Only use expert and verified content to limit the community conversations the agent uses to best answers, verified answers, and content written or created by community admins and experts. This setting is off by default.

claims.claim: Agent-written answers are used as knowledge only when a community admin or expert has marked them verified.
claims.quote: Answers written by Community Agent are used only if a community admin or expert has marked them as verified.

claims.claim: Any community admin can add a SharePoint site or library.
claims.quote: Any community admin can add a SharePoint site or library.

claims.claim: An admin with Full Control of a SharePoint site can grant the required access.
claims.quote: An admin with Full Control of the site can grant this access.

claims.claim: Adding a SharePoint site can add the community's Microsoft 365 group as a site visitor with Read permissions.
claims.quote: If prompted, select Grant access. The community's Microsoft 365 group is added as a site visitor with Read permissions only.

claims.claim: Site owners can remove the access granted to the community.
claims.quote: Full Control | Contains all available SharePoint permissions. By default, the Owners group has this permission level.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/understanding-permission-levels to sources for the site-owner permissions claim.

claims.claim: Files that do not inherit the site's permissions are not used by the agent.
claims.quote: Files that don't inherit the site's permissions aren't used by the agent.

claims.claim: Added SharePoint sites must have a sensitivity label at or below the community or backing group's label.
claims.quote: You can add SharePoint sites whose sensitivity label is at or below the label on the community or its backing Microsoft 365 group.

claims.claim: The agent checks sensitivity labels on relevant files and site pages when drafting each answer.
claims.quote: Community Agent also checks the sensitivity labels of relevant files and site pages when drafting each answer.

claims.claim: File sensitivity-label support applies to labels without encryption.
claims.quote: For files, this support applies to sensitivity labels without encryption.

claims.quote: Examples of unsupported SharePoint compliance features include Restricted Content Discovery, Information Barriers, Data Loss Prevention, Conditional Access, and Information Rights Management.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Support for those SharePoint compliance features is not currently planned for general availability.
claims.quote: Support for these features isn't currently planned for general availability.

claims.claim: The preview supports SharePoint team and communication sites only.
claims.quote: The preview release supports SharePoint team and communication sites only.

claims.quote: SharePoint sites and public websites share a total limit of 10 sites.

claims.claim: Approved answers and answers edited before posting are marked verified by the reviewer.
claims.quote: Approve | Post the answer as Community Agent. It is marked as verified by the reviewer. Edit | Edit the draft before posting it. The posted answer is marked as verified by the reviewer.

claims.claim: Community admins can delete posted agent answers.
claims.quote: Community admins can delete a posted agent answer.

claims.claim: The Skipped view explains why the agent skipped questions.

claims.claim: Drafting an answer can take a minute or two.
claims.quote: Drafting an answer can take a minute or two.

claims.claim: Automatic posting includes an additional wait.
claims.quote: Automatic posting includes an additional wait, so an answer may take several minutes to appear.

claims.quote: Add Community Agent to a community | Community admin | Microsoft 365 Copilot | Review, approve, or edit agent-drafted answers | Community admin or community expert | Microsoft 365 Copilot

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: General availability licensing for Community Agent is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Engage Community Agent license general availability'. Read Community Agent access requirements, Viva Engage Features service description and Viva service-description search excerpt; the feature-specific requirements are explicitly preview-only.

claims.claim: No Copilot Credits meter is documented for Community Agent, including at general availability.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Community Agent licensing Copilot Credits price'. Read Community Agent, Copilot Credits usage-based billing service list, and Copilot Studio billing excerpts; none identifies a Community Agent meter.

claims.claim: The Community Agent page publishes no price for the agent.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Community Agent licensing Copilot Credits price'. Read the full Community Agent page and billing search results; the feature page gives preview licence names, not an agent price.

claims.claim: General licence assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/users/{id | userPrincipalName}/assignLicense is a general Microsoft Graph operation that adds or removes user licences.
claims.quote: Add or remove licenses for the user to enable or disable their use of Microsoft cloud offerings that the company has licenses to. POST /users/{id | userPrincipalName}/assignLicense

claims.claim: The assignLicense request body uses addLicenses to specify licences to add.
claims.quote: addLicenses | assignedLicense collection | A collection of assignedLicense objects that specify the licenses to add.

claims.claim: The assignLicense request body uses removeLicenses to specify licences to remove.
claims.quote: removeLicenses | Guid collection | A collection of skuIds that identify the licenses to remove. Required. Can be an empty collection.

claims.claim: Licence assignment in the admin center requires at least a License or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: The Graph reference permits additional supported roles for delegated licence assignment.
claims.quote: The following least privileged roles are supported for this operation: Directory Writers; License Administrator; User Administrator

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell cmdlet is documented for the Community Agent preview toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Community Agent PowerShell preview' and 'Viva Engage Community Agent preview tenant settings API Graph beta PowerShell'. Read Community Agent and Viva Engage Graph overview; no operation sets the toggle.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell cmdlet is documented for the per-community Require review before posting setting.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Community Agent Graph settings API beta require review knowledge' and 'Community Agent PowerShell preview'. Read Community Agent, Viva Engage Graph overview and beta community resource; no documented review-setting write operation.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell cmdlet is documented for Community Agent knowledge-source settings.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Community Agent Graph settings API beta require review knowledge' and 'Community Agent PowerShell preview'. Read Community Agent, Viva Engage Graph overview and beta community resource; no documented agent knowledge-source write operation.

claims.claim: The preview toggle is the only currently documented tenant-level Community Agent control.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Community Agent require review network enforce tenant policy' and 'Community Agent general availability default'. Read Community Agent and relevant search excerpts; only the preview toggle has a current tenant configuration procedure.

claims.claim: No single network-wide control for enforcing answer review across communities is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Community Agent require review network enforce tenant policy'. Read Community Agent and relevant search results; review is configured per community, and no network-wide review-enforcement setting was found.

claims.claim: Community Agent audit logs cover setup, settings, knowledge-source additions and removals, SharePoint access grants and answer reviews.
claims.quote: These logs cover agent setup and settings, knowledge source additions and removals, SharePoint access grants, and answer reviews.

claims.claim: Searching Community Agent audit activities in Microsoft Purview requires Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs.
claims.quote: To search these activities in Microsoft Purview, you must be assigned the Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs role.

claims.claim: AgentSettingsUpdated is an audit operation for Community Agent settings changes.
claims.quote: Updated Community Agent settings | AgentSettingsUpdated | A community admin updates Community Agent settings.

claims.claim: SuggestedAnswerApproved is an audit operation for approving Community Agent answers.
claims.quote: Approved Community Agent suggested answer | SuggestedAnswerApproved | A community admin or community expert approves an answer suggested by Community Agent without editing it.
